notes.title: New Game: Thot On Trial
notes.content:
Our new game Thot On Trial is now available for                                      WISHLIST                    We hope you will check it out :) [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/eac971836a9251496edf9b3731246209b1911887.png"]
Thot on Trial is an adult visual novel that explores temptation, betrayal, and the slow unraveling of a marriage under pressure. With themes of NTR, power play, and moral corruption, this story invites you into a world where lust and ambition often collide, and consequences are inevitable. In this thrilling and steamy story, you get to control both the Female and Male character.

The story begins with a young couple moving from Chicago to Los Angeles. The husband is chasing his dream, starting a new job as an environmental lawyer. Idealistic and full of conviction, he's determined to take down a powerful corporation polluting the planet. The case is solid, but he's in over his head, and his lack of experience is starting to show.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/4f8e48091534eb4cc7199b36bc97998d67adda6e.png"]

The wife, stunning and full of charm, dreams of a quiet life with her husband's full attention. But the reality is far from perfect. As he spends longer hours at the office, buried in court filings and legal briefs, she's left alone, and bored. In today's economy, even dreams have a price, and she'll soon be searching for work of her own.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/2c052e61728d2953969628bdfe029f4e8e8aad0c.png"]

And then, there's Alexander. Smooth, powerful, and ruthless, he runs the very corporation the husband is trying to bring down. Alexander doesn't take defeat lightly. He wants to win. He wants control. And more than anything… he wants her.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/75d253806d293548464a06eca3a0ce3fd6f079c4.png"]

Anna, Alexander's top lawyer, is brilliant, ruthless, and dangerously seductive. Assigned to crush the case, she also sets her sights on the man fighting it. She'll make his life a legal nightmare, and something far more complicated.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/f28eb6b95ec0cc693fdab988bd49b270f0303e21.png"]

Along the way, you'll meet Jay, the charming next-door neighbor with impeccable timing. Trevor, the ex-boyfriend who never really let go. Charles, the mysterious boat captain with secrets of his own. And many others who will test loyalty, blur boundaries, and reshape what each character thought they knew about love, trust, and power.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/9733671d6f6e44210d3b83790fdd7e47c17dadf9.png"]

Thot on Trial offers branching paths, layered relationships, and a slow descent into choices that can't be taken back. Will the husband stay true to his mission, or lose everything chasing a world that never loved him back?

These are just some of the characters. Play along and meet all kinds of people who might make the story even more complicated... or interesting?

Every decision matters. Every glance means more than it seems. And in the end, you decide how far the corruption goes.  

WISHLIST

notes.title: Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.9
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's time for a regular update and dev blog post, all wrapped into one big message. If you're only interested in the changes included in this update, scroll to the bottom—and most importantly, enjoy the game!

First off, happy Easter to everyone! We hope you're doing well, and may this holiday bring you peace, warmth, and a little bit of chocolatey joy.

In this update, we’ll walk you through everything we've been working on and what's coming next. About a month ago, many of you told us you'd like longer updates to see where your investment is going—and we’re delivering exactly that. If there’s one thing we’re known for, it’s listening to our players and working hard to make ULT the best game both you and we dream of.

Oh, and before we dive in—we're giving away 2 Lovense toys! More details on that at the end of this post.

New Characters!
Let’s start with something many of you have been waiting for: the final characters needed for the story are now in the game! That’s right—Nicole and Zoe have arrived!
They’re still in their default poses, waiting for you to interact with them, but you can now check them out in full 3D and test new animations.

 Find Zoe in Megan’s room
 Find Nicole in the classroom, staring at the black screen (suggest what we should put on it!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/3b5dab4232a18464596c5576246b77387e19c16d.jpg
New Animations
This update brings 5 new animations to the game! Huge congrats again to the winners of our speedrun competition—and yes, some of your animation suggestions are now in the game too.
Let us know what you think, because our talented animator keeps leveling up with every update (we sure think so!).

 Jessica – new animation during conversation
 Nicole – 2 new animations + a special one
 Zoe – 2 new animations + a special one

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/ebf95cc143fe5cf8006c19ed92d6fb3ddad15455.jpg
New Area – "PE Hall"
We’re introducing a brand-new map in progress: the PE Hall! (We’re still not sure about the name—here in Croatia we call it something else—so feel free to suggest a better name.)

You’ll find it upstairs in the college. Check it out, let us know what to add or change, and keep in mind it’s still a work in progress—yes, the showers are coming soon, and they’ll include some... special quests. ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/ee31d69e0b85911a9a3d9d8cfcce339cb771899f.jpg

Open World Blockout Updates
The blockout for the open world is improving with each update. Here's what’s new:

 Skyscrapers where Elizabeth and Sophie will work are starting to take shape
 The environment is also coming along nicely!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/c0066ca565007f2c49abc1e08d3f367847f41d1d.jpg
NPCs, Cars & World Life – Sneak Peek
Special announcement! One of our teammates is working on making the world feel more alive.
It's still early, but here’s what’s coming:

 Random NPCs who walk around or interact with you
 Vehicles and traffic (yep, cars—even if they don’t have wheels yet 😅)

We’re not releasing this just yet because it’s buggy, but trust us, we heard your feedback, and we're making it happen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/879494d1994f8d8bb7ccd77d4f55495945b7fc4a.jpg

Okay that's it for the text part, here are the changes for Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.9:

 Updated Easter Quest – now unlockable and tied to its achievement
 New map: PE_Hall
 Pushed all visible map changes
 Added Nicole character
 2 animations + special ones
 Added Zoe character
 2 animations + special ones
 1 new Jessica bed animation + special ones
 19 exclusive Easter wallpapers – complete the quest to unlock them
 Lovense discount via our special link
 Bug fixes (including ones you reported)
 Fixed the "Going Only Up" achievement
 Added Minigames in the MainMenu (you can’t save the game from there tho)



Lovense Partnership Details
We’re excited to share more about our partnership with Lovense:
https://www.lovense.com/a/IncetonGames

 Get Lovense toys with a 55% discount using our link – the offer lasts until the end of the month!
 In May, during Lovense’s annual Orgy Event on X, we’ll buy one toy for a random player who participates, and give some keys. That event is a big deal, and they’re really popular for it—so when they asked us to participate, we said, 'Why not?' After all, we’re giving the gifts to our players.
 We’re also working on adding a Giveaway Button directly in ULT—click it to participate in a second toy giveaway. Details coming soon!


Final Words
As always, we want to say a huge thank you. You’re the real foundation of this game, and your support means everything to us.

If I missed something in this post, don’t worry—we’ll keep sharing more updates as we go.
With respect and love,
– The ULT Team

notes.title: Happy 1st Anniversary, Unreal Lust Theory!
notes.content:
Can you believe it’s been a whole year since we launched Unreal Lust Theory into Early Access? It was released on March 29, 2024, with just 21 animations, 3 quests, and 3 girls—and look at us now! This incredible journey wouldn’t have been possible without your unwavering support, passion, and patience. Here’s a heartfelt thank you and a small recap of our adventure so far!

Together, we’ve achieved so much:

 Almost 5,000 followers on Steam, plus many more on other platforms, helping shape Unreal Lust Theory with your feedback, ideas, and bug reports.
 8 major updates and 7 smaller ones, along with 7 developer updates and 1 big blog post (with the next one coming on Monday!).
 Over 80 new main animations, new clothing, a new main character, 3 new maps, house improvements, more girls, new mechanics, clothing options, cum, quests, countless fixes based on your feedback, and so much more...


Some of the biggest additions and improvements:

 Full keybinding customization and Lovense integration for a more immersive experience.
 Started work on realistic cum animations for different scenarios.
 Completed Sophie, the final character from Lust Theory Season 1, with motion and face capture for better animations.
 142 cum animations, jiggle physics, and a system for changing clothes in sex scenes.
 Cum and clothing options in sex scenes, and performance improvements.
 Skin wetness, change speed, and multiple camera angles
 Announced Steam Community Items, sci-fi clothing, new animations, and a reworked Main Menu for future features.
 New UI for pose switching, a Hide MC option, and exclusive wallpapers.
 Completely reworked UI, introduced a new Main Menu and a new Save System (with multiple save slots).
 Ellie animations, a new grab item function, and house interior updates.
 New system for conversations and interactions with improved mechanics.
 Update to newest Unreal Engine.
 3 seasonal in-game events (Easter, Halloween, and Christmas) with unique achievements, scenery, and animations.
 Open world, College interiors, a speedrun map, and a minigame.
 Multiple languages so more players can enjoy it in their native language.
 Game optimizations and performance improvements.
 A heartwarming Steam review score of 74.22%, with hundreds of players sharing their love for Unreal Lust Theory.
 And probably a lot more! (Help me out in the comments 😆)


And this is just the beginning!
As we enter our second year, we want to emphasize that your feedback, suggestions, and enthusiasm are the driving force behind our progress. Keep sharing your ideas, reporting bugs, and helping us make Unreal Lust Theory the best 3D adult game possible. 

We will continue working on the Story and deliver what you want, with good Sandbox mode and the mechanics we’ve developed. No rushing, just quality—we promise to deliver the best game possible. Let us amaze you with everything we have planned for Year 2!

Here’s to another year of gaming together! 

ULT Team, Seenko

notes.title: Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.8.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.8.0.1 is now live!

First of all, thank you all for the amazing feedback! You really helped us out and made this bug fix much easier — everything went smoothly. We used this week to finish up Sandbox mode, and starting Monday, we’re jumping back into Story mode. Fixing issues and finding bugs was super important because both Sandbox and Story share the same features. So if it works in one, it should work in the other — with new content added for the Story, of course.

We faced a lot of bugs in this release, but we expected that since we added new maps and a new character. Those changes forced us to update everything — from the UI to the save system. We think this new approach of giving you early access to an unfinished build was a success. Thanks to your help, we fixed a lot of important issues. Next week, the entire team is fully focused on Story mode — and the best part is we don’t have to waste time finding bugs or other issues you already reported and suggested improvements for.

You can expect the next update for testing sometime around Easter, and we’ll have a new blog post coming soon.

Bug Fixes and Changes:


 Nicole’s animation is now unlocked for everyone, not just for those who completed the speed run.
 Fixed saving and loading — we recommend deleting old saves.
 Fixed the save screenshot being taken inside the MC’s head.
 Fixed inverted mouse scroll — scroll up for first-person camera, scroll down for third-person camera.
 Fixed golden holograms — they can now only be activated after completing the hologram quest.
 General quest fixes — quests now save even when changing maps.
 Fixed getting stuck on reported assets — you can’t jump on them anymore.
 You can now jump over the second-floor railing, but the MC will briefly get stuck in the air for one second.
 Fixed passing through girls — you can’t walk through them anymore.
 Added more hints.
 Seasonal quests are now playable (start a new game with Windows date and time set).
 Commands menu fixed — teleport is hidden unless you’re in Open World.
 Fixed the MC getting stuck on the basement stairs.
 Fixed TV sound playing when the TV is turned off.
 Fixed random teleportation when leaving sex scenes.
 Fixed toggle sprint on/off.


Known or Minor Bugs:


 In Open World, if you get stuck, walk outside the map. This will change once we start replacing assets with original ones.
 Save files are not named correctly — we’ll change that later to attach saves to the player’s name.
 Grab distance is inconsistent.
 Hair clipping through bodies — we’re still looking for the best solution.
 Drone zooming in and out — this feature will be removed.
 "Quest Succeeded" should technically be "Quest Completed", but we prefer "Quest Succeeded".


That’s it! Thank you for your patience and support. If you find anything else in the latest update, feel free to report it or suggest changes. You know we listen to our players — you’re the most important part of this project.

Enjoy the weekend,
ULT Team

notes.title: Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.8
notes.content:
Our dear Players, 

Are you ready to test out the new features we're working on? From now on, we’re giving you access to everything we have (except the story). Starting with this version, you’ll receive unfinished, rough builds that may be buggy and incomplete—but they also give you an exclusive look at how your investment is shaping the game. 

Sandbox mode was always meant to work like this: giving you everything we have for testing and playing. If this new approach leads to negative feedback or makes you unhappy, we’ll go back to the old system. But if you enjoy it and it adds excitement to your experience, we’ll keep expanding it and give you even more to test and play with. So let us know what you think! 

One more thing—we have a feedback option now for all platforms in the same place! If you have any thoughts, please visit LINK. 

Let's talk a little about Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.8! 

We’ve added three new work-in-progress maps for you to try out and share your thoughts on. The first one is the outdoor area—yes, you can go outside the house now! Keep in mind that it’s just a blockout, meaning it hasn’t been optimized or replaced with final assets yet. The second is a mini-game—don’t hate us, please! It’s something fun that we plan to expand with more assets, not just blocks. The third is the college interior, which introduces a new environment to explore. You can switch between these areas using doors, and for the mini-game, you’ll find its entrance in the middle of the park.

Main Character Updates

The main character has been added to the game. We’ve noticed some proportion issues inside the house, and those will be fixed in upcoming updates. MC animations are still not fully adjusted; we just made them work, and now we’ll make them look better. This is a big one because it’s something you’ve been asking for a lot, and now we finally have a working version. You can switch cameras between first-person and third-person using Num 1 or 2, or simply by scrolling.

Nicole’s Animation Test

One of our amazing animators wanted to give you an early Nicole animation for testing! She worked hard to finish at least one simple animation this week. You can get it as a reward for finishing the mini-game.

But don’t worry—if the mini-game is too difficult or not your style, Nicole’s fully completed animations will soon be available in the college interior map. This first animation was originally planned for April, so consider this an early sneak peek as a thank-you for your support and patience! 

Quick summary for this update:


 1 new Jessica kissing animation + special animations
 1 new Nicole mini-game animation
 Blockout map: Outside world - City of Lustridge
 College interior map
 Mini-game map
 New achievement: Going Only Up
 New main character + clothing + 2 views
 New animations for the main character
 Teleport system changed to work only in the outside world
 1 new quest for the mini-game
 Various fixes and adjustments
 New sandbox message—please read before playing
 Translations updated for all reported languages


There are probably other things we did that aren’t mentioned here, but these are definitely the most important ones for this update. Please share your thoughts and ideas!

P.S. We are organizing a speedrun competition. You can find more about it on our Discord.

Enjoy the game—we can’t wait for you to test it out.
Best regards,
ULT Team

notes.title: Unreal Lust Theory - Dev Blog Post + BTS images and videos
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We noticed you haven’t heard from the Unreal team in exactly two weeks, so we wanted to prepare something special for you—after all, you deserve it! Your support is incredible and means so much to us. In the spirit of that, our team has gathered some images and videos to show you what we’ve been working on, along with a little description of everything happening right now.
Dev blog posts aren’t something we’ve done before—maybe once—but if you like them, I can post updates like this regularly. It’s not a problem! Let us know what you think in the comments below. Get ready for an inside look behind the scenes! These images and videos aren’t polished or ready for publishing, but why keep you in the dark? We want to show you what we’re working on and what’s coming next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/54e2b30f48f6bc03925ab44780a7130e52827b4c.jpg

The City of Lustridge

First things first, we present to you Lustridge, the city carefully designed to fit our story. Every building is placed where it needs to be—not too big, not too small—ensuring a playable, explorable, and optimized environment so that everyone can enjoy it. Keep in mind this is only the blockout phase; we’ll start replacing the placeholders with final assets once we agree with Lancelot that everything is perfect for our story and future DLC expansions.

We already have ideas for the beach area and for someone you’ll love 😉, but we’ll discuss that later. Right now, our main goal is to deliver a complete Unreal Lust Theory game, and only then will we focus on the extra content you’ll love, need, and ask for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/5b73740f928d3300846c3f7515d3fb4bf9b8f75e.jpg

We started by taking the original Lust Theory map, placing it in top-down view, and designing roads and sections that make sense. The original spirit of the game will live on in this version, and we’re doing our best to bring back everything you loved. If you’ve played LT1 or LT2, you’ll recognize the suburbs where the MC lives, the college, big buildings, stores, etc. One change, though—we’re removing the mall because it’s too big and not really necessary. Instead, we’re repurposing one of the large buildings.

Here’s how it works:

 Hall 1: Leads to Elizabeth’s office (a new location that wasn’t in the original game). You’ll finally know where she works, and special scenes will happen there! More story for you!
 Hall 2: Leads to Sophie’s shop.
 The old mall area will be replaced with a chill downtown featuring coffee shops, etc.


Third & First-Person Character Returns
Another big update—we’re bringing back the Third & First-Person Character in ULT, enhanced with all the new features Epic Games has provided. You can check out the new character on our YouTube channel. The clothing and character model are still in development, and some things don’t meet our expectations yet—so please be patient! We’ll fix everything step by step.

With this character, we’ve already started brainstorming OnlyHard Up minigames, paintball, and more. Feel free to suggest ideas—we always consider them!

Exploration & Story Progress
The entire world will be explorable, with collectibles for those who enjoy that. The story is progressing—Day 1 is 10% done. Don’t hate us! 😆 We’re testing everything, and so far, it looks good. Some issues still need solutions, but with this team, there’s nothing we can’t figure out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/942ee1f1a86b30298646c64986efb58d8156c750.jpg

Elizabeth’s Work Outfit
We’re also designing work clothes for Elizabeth, so you’ll finally see her at work! We still need to texture the outfit, but here’s the general idea. Bra and panties are also part of this outfit, so just imagine what you’ll try to do when you visit her at work… 😉

For this video visit our WEBPAGE:

Facial Expressions in Dialogues
One major feature—which many of you warned us was necessary—is facial expressions in dialogues! Here’s a quick video to show you what we’ve got. Every girl now has perfect facial expressions recorded using the Face Capture app on our mobile phone.
Our in-house artist is working on dialogue animations for Day 1, and we’ll give her voice lines and video references to the voice actresses you already know and love. The result? Even better quality later in development!

________________________________________

Final Thoughts
A lot has happened in just two weeks, and this was a quick summary of the most important things we wanted to show you. Please give us more time to develop the perfect adult game.
We’re on the right track, having meetings, good management, and tons of overtime to bring you something special—something that means a lot to us, and hopefully, to you too.
We’ll stick to our plan, but if you see something you’d like changed, now’s the time to suggest it!

Thank You & Have a Great Weekend!
With love,
ULT Team

notes.title: Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.7.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Once again, let's start by deleting UnrealLustTheory_PCD3D_SM6.upipelinecache from:
C:\Users\YOUR NAME\AppData\Local\UnrealLustTheory\Saved

After that, create a new folder with the same name: UnrealLustTheory_PCD3D_SM6.upipelinecache—this will prevent it from being recreated. The driver manufacturer still hasn’t fixed this issue, but we’ve reached out to them and will make sure it gets resolved in the future.

If you want to see what’s changed in update v0.3.7.0.1, check the end of this post.

------------------------------------------------------------------

Now, hi guys, and thank you so much for your feedback! We've taken many of your suggestions and started implementing them into the world of Unreal Lust Theory. For today’s update, we don’t have much new content, but we do have a lot to talk about.

First, we updated the promo images, and we hope you like them. After all this time, we finally figured out how to get 4K renders in UE5, so what you see now is something made directly in Unreal Engine—and the results are amazing.

What have we been working on this month?
A lot! I’m really proud of this team, and we want you to know that we’re giving everything we have to make Story Mode great.

First, we’ve separated Story Mode from Sandbox Mode. Story Mode will remain locked for now because we don’t want negative reviews from people clicking on it and finding an empty house or map. We’ll slowly start sharing in-game renders so you can see our progress.

We’ve also added nine different times of day:
Morning 1-2, Noon, Afternoon 1-2, Evening 1-2, Night 1-2.
Why? More content, more options, more Story time. 😃 That part is now complete and ready for testing.

What’s next?
The testing phase starts next week.
We’ll be testing dialogue animations, body and facial animations, NPC spawning, schedules, cinematics, and much more. This month, we focused on writing the necessary C++ code and setting up the UE5 systems needed for this phase.

We’ve also separated hairstyles for each girl, allowing for more variety and customization. This system is working, but you’ll hear more about it later this year.

Nicole and Zoe have now been imported into the project. There are still some fixes to be made, but once our guy finishes his work and we wrap up testing, you’ll get to try them out too.

Open World Progress
The open-world map is coming along really well. We used the original map for inspiration, and it’s improving every day. Right now, it’s still in the blockout phase—meaning we’re building everything with grey and white blocks to finalize the layout before replacing them with actual assets. The goal is to make the world big enough to feel immersive but not empty or boring. If you want to see renders of it, we can share them next month.

Final Notes
A lot of planning and discussions went into this month, but we’ve now figured out almost everything we need. That means development should be faster and smoother moving forward.

Our main focus now is getting Day 1 of Story Mode ready, so expect fewer updates than before. We hope you understand—we’re doing this to prioritize the most important content.

Your ideas have been incredibly helpful. Thank you for being here since Day 1 and helping us shape this game. Let’s make Unreal Lust Theory one of the best out there!

------------------------------------------------------------------

What’s new/changed in this update?

 Christmas event removed, but you can still activate it by changing your PC date and time and starting a new game
 Keybindings added for the drone in special scenes (as requested)
 Two new Sophie animations + a special inside and outside cum animation
 Removed Sophie’s present, placed her on the couch, and updated her clothing
 Fixed some reported bugs (except the camera issue in special scenes)

To navigate back, look for a path like .../Path/AppData/Roaming at the top of the File Explorer and click AppData to return to the main directory.

notes.title: ULT v0.3.6.0.2 Future Plans, Updates, and What’s Next
notes.content:
Hey everyone, let’s get straight to the point. Here’s what’s included in today’s update:

Halloween Event Removed
- Thank you all for being part of Halloween 2024! We received amazing feedback, and we’re glad you enjoyed it. You can still replay 2/3 of the quests to complete the achievement by setting your time and date to October and starting a new game. Next year, we’ll make it even better—we can’t wait to compare the 2024 and 2025 events!

Missing Animations Added
- We added four missing animations for the threesome golden hologram in Jessica’s Room.

Cuddle Animations Added
- At your request, we added cuddle animations! One is now available in Megan’s room (bed animations) and another in Elizabeth’s room (bed animations). Let us know what you think—if needed, we can include more in the story.

Partial Controller Support
- Controller support has been partially implemented. Currently, it works for the main character and the drone. Some main menu settings are accessible with a controller, but we don’t recommend using it just yet. Full controller support should be ready in a few weeks.

Czech Translations Fixed
- We fixed the Czech translations! If you’d like to help spellcheck or improve translations for your language, contact .seenko on Discord.

Pause Functionality Added
- Pressing ESC or the Panic button now pauses the game.

What’s Next?

Now that you know what’s included in v0.3.6.0.2, let’s talk about our plans. We’ve been releasing updates almost every Friday—big or small—but for now, we need to pause 
this schedule.

Why? Because we need to focus on Story Mode and finalizing core mechanics. Future updates will be released when we’re ready or if we need your help testing.

Here’s what’s coming next:

Update to Unreal Engine 5.5
- This upgrade will take time, as we’ll need to fix everything that breaks during the transition. However, the new version offers significant upgrades and solutions we can’t ignore.

Separate Story and Sandbox Modes
- We’ll split the house into separate maps for Story Mode and Sandbox Mode. This allows us to reuse the same map without duplicating it, making room for an open-world experience in Story Mode.

Player Character Body and Animations
- We plan to add a body for the player character with basic animations. (Face and hair customization won’t be available for now, maybe in the future)

Dialogue and Walking Animations
- Work will begin on dialogue animations and fixing the girls’ walking animations.

New Characters
- More characters will be added to the game.

New Clothing Options
- More clothes will be added to the game.

College Location Testing
- The college location will be completed and made available for testing.

New Locations and Mechanics
- We’ll develop additional locations and mechanics for Story Mode.

Full Controller and Steam Deck Support
- We’re working towards full controller support, including compatibility with Steam Deck.

Christmas Event
- Prepare Christmas event

“Day 1” of Story Mode
- Start on the first day of Story Mode.

There is probably something else that will be added to this list, but for now, you can see why we have to stop with the updates every Friday. We'll try to give you something when we're ready, but our main focus will be the Story mode and giving you the game you asked for a long time ago. We think now is the best time to start it because a lot of stuff is ready for the Story, and your feedback has helped us in creating and preparing for this moment.

We’re incredibly grateful for your patience and support. Every penny earned from this game has gone straight back into its development. With the help of a talented new animator and our dedicated team, we’re ready to take things to the next level.

Thank you for being part of this journey!


Until next time,
The ULT Team

Polishing the characters and providing you with the best visuals is important, and we want to give you the best game possible. The biggest changes will be on MC and Megan, but after them, the other characters will be done more quickly. They will appear in the Updates according to the poll votes on our Discord: 1. Nicole, 2. Ellie, 3. Zoe, 4. Sophie, but maybe we should publish Sophie first, after all, she is finished and the reason we are doing all of this :D Let me know in the comments below. 

With this new character approach, motion capturing and face capture are now possible, meaning we can provide you with even better animations and, finally, real-feel dialogues.

We are so grateful for your support and this community. In return, we are doing our best to give you our maximum effort and a finished product, not something half done. Giving you the best characters is important, and with this approach, we believe this game will be even better than we thought.

Thank you for being here. That’s it for this character info. I'm here for your questions.

notes.title: 🎮 Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.1 Patch Notes 🎮
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/ff1f971d7d3c8666e1532083ff2c3bb2e7f2ec28.jpg

Greetings everyone!

We've wrote down all of your much-needed feedback and ideas, and we've begun implementing them after a short, but necessary break. Thank you so much for your invaluable support; we truly appreciate each and every one of you! While there are still a few more issues to address, such as the save option, but for it we need to re-do whole main menu (which will take some time), we're excited to share this update with you:

NOTE: Price of the game with this update won't change.

🛠️ Improvements:


 Fixed clipping issues in animations.
 Added keybindings; now all controls except for the default skip dialogue (left ctrl) can be customized to your preference.
 Added 96+ images for keybindings, allowing your controls widget to display any key you've inserted or changed (images are for US layout).
 Updated the appearance of default sex and normal controls.
 In Drone mode, right-click now displays the exit option for sex scenes, replacing the previous ESC key function.
 ESC key now functions to exit windows; no need to click exit with the mouse.
 ENTER key works now when entering names, you don't need to click accept anymore
 SANDBOX mode can now be played only using the keyboard.
 Implemented community-suggested feature: the punching bag now reacts to punches, with added physics.


🐞 Bug Fixes:


 Resolved mouse sensitivity and mouse invert issues.
 Fixed inability to exit Quest Journal with ESC key.
 Addressed instances of getting stuck in Elizabeth's room.
 Fixed mouse locking in-app, ensuring the mouse remains within the monitor screen.
 Corrected issue where mirrors on medium graphics did not display walls.
 Adjusted UI scaling.
 Improved functionality of leaving dialogues without requiring additional input (note: first dialogue with Jessica cannot be skipped, as she needs to provide a quest).
 ESC key in sex scene now properly exits to the pause menu.
 Fixed inability to open or close the garage door.


🗺️ Localization:

Fixed words and sentences for reported languages only. Updated languages: French, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Indonesian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazilian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian.

🌟 Upcoming Features:


 Cum inside and outside animations and fluids are currently in progress; expect to test them out in approximately one more week.
 sexy clothes for girls are in the making, more info coming soon
 new Main Menu and controller support, more info coming soon
 Updates on other characters will be revealed in the next update


📣 Community Feedback:
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to our amazing community for their invaluable feedback and support. We couldn't do any of this without you! Your passion and enthusiasm continue to inspire us every day, and we're committed to delivering the best possible gaming experience for all of you. Together, let's make Unreal Lust Theory the ultimate gaming experience!

As always, if you encounter any issues or have suggestions for future updates, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our official Discord server or our Community hub. 

Happy gaming!
ULT team!
